commands.command:
set -eu
i=0
state=
code=
while [ "$i" -lt 25 ]; do
  state=$(systemctl is-active minio.service 2>/dev/null || true)
  code=$(curl -sS --cacert /etc/minio/certs/CAs/cluster-ca.crt --connect-timeout 2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://$NODE_IP:9000/minio/health/cluster" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ "$state" = active ] && [ "$code" = 200 ] && break
  i=$((i+1))
  sleep 2
done
printf 'node=%s boot_id=' "$NODE_NAME"
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'minio_active=%s recovery_attempts=%s\n' "$state" "$i"
printf 'tls_cluster_health=%s\n' "$code"
printf 'listener='
ss -lnt | awk -v p="$NODE_IP:9000" '$4==p{print $4; found=1} END{exit !found}'
for object in proof.txt member-outage-proof.txt; do
  printf '%s_shard=' "$object"
  test -f "/srv/minio/data/infra-data/$object/xl.meta"
  stat -c 'present bytes=%s' "/srv/minio/data/infra-data/$object/xl.meta"
done
[ "$state" = active ] && [ "$code" = 200 ]
